title: Fix admin password verification — SHA-256 hash mismatch between frontend and canister

requirements.text: Rewrite `frontend/src/utils/hashPassword.ts` so that it hashes the input password string using SubtleCrypto SHA-256 (Web Crypto API), encodes the string as UTF-8 bytes via `TextEncoder`, digests it, and converts the resulting ArrayBuffer to a lowercase hex string with no spaces, dashes, or prefixes. The function must not trim, normalize, or transform the password string before encoding. Verify that calling this function with the string `qwet1234` produces the hex output `6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e`.

quotes: rewrite hashPassword.ts to produce a clean, verified lowercase hex SHA-256 digest using the Web Crypto API

acceptanceCriteria: hashPassword('qwet1234') resolves to exactly '6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e' (lowercase, no extra characters)
The function uses TextEncoder to encode the raw password string before passing it to SubtleCrypto digest
The ArrayBuffer result is converted to hex by reading each byte as a 2-digit lowercase hex value
No trimming, case-folding, or other password transformation is applied before hashing

requirements.text: Update `backend/main.mo` to store the correct SHA-256 hex hash of the password `qwet1234` in the stable variable used by `verifyAdminPassword`. The stored hash must be exactly `6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e` (64 lowercase hex characters). The `verifyAdminPassword(passwordHash: Text) -> async Bool` function must perform a strict equality comparison between the incoming `passwordHash` argument and this stored value, returning `true` only on an exact match.

quotes: update backend/main.mo to store the exact correct SHA-256 hash of 'qwet1234' (which is 6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e)

acceptanceCriteria: The stable variable for the admin password hash is set to '6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e'
verifyAdminPassword with any other string returns false
The raw password 'qwet1234' is never stored or returned by any canister function

requirements.text: Update `backend/migration.mo` to set the `adminPasswordHash` stable variable to the correct value `6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e` so that the migration overwrites any previously stored incorrect hash on canister upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: After a canister upgrade, verifyAdminPassword correctly accepts the hash of 'qwet1234'

requirements.text: Audit `frontend/src/components/AdminAuthGuard.tsx` to confirm it calls `hashPassword(enteredPassword)` before passing the result to the canister's `verifyAdminPassword` function, and that no additional transformation (trim, toLowerCase, etc.) is applied to the password between user input and the hashing call. If any such transformation exists, remove it so the raw entered string is passed directly to `hashPassword`.

quotes: No not working saying wrong password now set and try to find issue and solve it

acceptanceCriteria: AdminAuthGuard passes the password value directly to hashPassword without trimming or casing
The hex string returned by hashPassword is passed as-is to verifyAdminPassword on the canister
Entering 'qwet1234' in the password prompt and clicking Login grants access (sessionStorage adminAuthenticated = 'true') and renders the admin panel
Entering any other password shows 'Incorrect password. Please try again.' inline error

constraints: Do not change any other admin panel UI or behavior — only the hash value and hashing utility
Do not store or expose the raw password 'qwet1234' anywhere in frontend or backend code
The stored hash in backend/main.mo must be exactly '6b3a55e0261b0304143f805a24924d0c1c44524821305f31d9277843b8a10f4e'
nonGoals: Changing the admin password from 'qwet1234' to anything else
Adding Internet Identity or any other authentication mechanism
Modifying any other backend functions or data models
Changing the admin panel UI after successful authentication
